title: Figure Rig
hero_prompt: A wide anatomical woodcut engraving, in the style of a Vesalius plate, of a striding female figure mid-stride, her joints marked as small circled pivot points at hip, knee, and ankle like a living armature. Fine crosshatched ink lines render muscle and bone giving way to bare articulation at the joints. The figure strides confidently across a plain paper ground, evoked rather than portrayed as a specific person.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast emblem of a single ball-and-socket joint — a thick engraved circle pierced by two crossing limb-lines — rendered as stark black woodcut linework on a pale ground, no fine crosshatching, reading clearly as a small mark.
